description.value: Roti Wala brings authentic Bangladeshi street food to Vancouver's Kingsway corridor, serving fresh daily rotis made on a tawa each morning, fragrant beef tehari biryani rooted in Old Dhaka tradition, and handcrafted masala chai alongside espresso drinks. The menu spans fuchka, chotpoti, golden samosas, and housemade nankhatai butter cookies — a genuinely distinctive stop for cyclists seeking a hearty, culturally rich meal. Indoor seating is available and no outdoor seating is offered.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 30m; stands (5 spaces) at 44m; rack at 95m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business name, address (with full postal code), and adds a phone number not present in OSM. No bike-related amenities, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content — all required criteria remain unconfirmed. The website's 'Contact Us to place an order' phrasing and snack-house format support takeout as an available service.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; phone (604) 715-6817 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
OSM name uses 'Cafe'; website consistently uses 'Café' (with accent) — minor typographic discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active restaurant confirmed via website, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification is needed before inclusion.

wow_evidence: authentic Bangladeshi street food to Vancouver's Kingsway corridor
